title: Factbox-Large foreign investments in India's financial sector in recent months
title_zh: Factbox-近几个月印度金融业的大量外国投资
summary: By Gopika Gopakumar MUMBAI, Aug 13 (Reuters) - India's financial sector has seen several major deals since last year, including rare transactions involving foreign banks and financial institutions
summary_zh: 路透孟买 8 月 13 日 - 自去年以来，印度金融业已发生多起重大交易，其中包括涉及外国银行和金融机构的罕见交易

title: S&P 500 ends higher as CoreWeave results fuel AI optimism
title_zh: CoreWeave 业绩推动人工智能乐观情绪，标普 500 指数收高

title: Expert urges investors to spread bets across the 'AI universe'
title_zh: 专家敦促投资者将赌注分散到“人工智能领域”
summary: STORY: Mussio also noted that "investors are right to concern themselves" with companies' capital expenditures on AI buildout."The market is rewarding those businesses that can finance the CapEx still within the guise of their cash flow from operations," Mussio said.
summary_zh: 故事：Mussio 还指出，“投资者对公司在人工智能建设上的资本支出感到担忧是正确的。”Mussio 表示，“市场正在奖励那些能够以运营现金流为幌子为资本支出提供资金的企业。”

title: Google’s Pixel 11 isn’t the story; Gemini AI is
title_zh: 谷歌的 Pixel 11 并不是故事，而是故事。双子座人工智能是
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination Overtime to discuss Google's (GOOG, GOOGL) new Pixel 11 smartphone lineup and its deeper integration of Gemini AI.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑与 Josh Lipton 一起讨论《市场统治加班》，讨论 Google（GOOG、GOOGL）的全新 Pixel 11 智能手机系列及其对 Gemini AI 的更深入集成。

title: Tech just got cheaper - what it means for the bull market
title_zh: 科技股变得更便宜——这对牛市意味着什么
summary: In today's Chart of the Day, Yahoo Finance Markets & Data Editor Jared Blikre breaks down the tech market’s latest reset, why valuations are becoming more attractive even as earnings remain strong, and what it could mean for the broader bull market heading into the end of the ...
summary_zh: 在今天的每日图表中，雅虎金融市场和数据编辑贾里德·布利克（Jared Blikre）详细分析了科技市场的最新重置，为什么即使盈利仍然强劲，估值却变得更具吸引力，以及这对进入年底的更广泛的牛市意味着什么......

title: Nvidia partners with Goldman Sachs, BlackRock to fund AI build-out — but there's one big risk
title_zh: 英伟达与高盛、贝莱德合作资助人工智能建设——但存在一个很大的风险
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is partnering with BlackRock (BLK), Goldman Sachs (GS), Blackstone (BX), and other major firms on Wall Street to fund its AI build-out.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (NVDA) 正在与贝莱德 (BLK)、高盛 (GS)、黑石 (BX) 和华尔街其他主要公司合作，为其人工智能建设提供资金。

title: CoreWeave, Nebius soar as AI spending powers growth
title_zh: 随着人工智能支出的增长，CoreWeave 和 Nebius 飙升
summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) and Nebius (NBIS) shares skyrocket following earnings, as revenue surges to “stupid” levels and demand for AI infrastructure continues to soar. Both companies are benefiting from an AI spending boom that is accelerating faster than Wall Street expected.
summary_zh: CoreWeave (CRWV) 和 Nebius (NBIS) 的股价在盈利后飙升，因为收入飙升至“愚蠢”的水平，并且对人工智能基础设施的需求持续飙升。两家公司都受益于人工智能支出热潮，其加速速度超出了华尔街的预期。

title: Google launches Pixel 11 smartphone line, including Pixel 11 Pro Fold, as Apple preps foldable iPhone
title_zh: 随着苹果准备可折叠 iPhone，谷歌推出 Pixel 11 智能手机系列，包括 Pixel 11 Pro Fold
summary: Google debuted its Pixel 11 line of smartphones on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 谷歌于周三推出了 Pixel 11 系列智能手机。

title: Tech leads sectors higher in early trading as chip stocks gain: AlphaCheck
title_zh: 随着芯片股上涨，科技股在早盘交易中引领板块走高：AlphaCheck
summary: Stocks traded higher on Wednesday after the Consumer Price Index report showed inflation moderated in July amid volatile oil price moves during the month.
summary_zh: 周三，消费者物价指数报告显示，由于油价波动，7 月份通胀有所放缓，股市周三走高。
